Yet NavUser.vue is only referenced by AppSidebar, which is used by AppSidebarLayout, used by Dashboard.vue — and Dashboard is not routed. The route is only "/" -> MainPage which doesn't use those layouts.

But Vite build fails because NavUser.vue is included in the build graph (Vite builds all modules reachable from app.ts?
